jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Engineer – Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description:
Do you want to own procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a commercially sharp engineer who wants to master the technology in depth and grow into a skilled procurement professional – in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.
What will you do at NYAB? 
As our Technical Procurement Engineer, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, driving procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. You get real responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side as you grow into the full scope of the role.
Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions.
In this role, you will: 
Own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.

Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.

Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.

Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable-energy projects and make our supply-chain more resilient.

Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver.

You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does – and spotting opportunities for optimization.

About you
You are strongly goal-oriented, a self-starter with plenty of grit and a natural talent for making things happen. You bring commercial instinct, sound judgment and a genuine hunger to learn – both the technology and the art of dealmaking. For you, speed and precision go hand in hand: you take ownership of your commitments and willingly go the extra mile when it matters – while building trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners along the way.
 We believe you have: 
A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems – recently graduated or planned graduation in 2027.

Previous experience from procurement, engineering, project work, construction, energy or another technically oriented environment. 

A strong interest in sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations.

Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad.

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience from sourcing, supplier contacts or commercial work.

Knowledge of solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.

Why work at NYAB? 
NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it.
Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise.
You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow.
We also offer:

Comprehensive health assessments 

Generous wellness allowance  -

Parental pay supplement

Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)

A secure pension plan 

 
Ready to make it happen?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and academic records. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. Join us in building technology that drives real change.
Machine Learning Engineer at Sellpy
We look for you who want to be part of our journey to make sustainable shopping the first-hand choice by building great product recommendations, creating clever pricing algorithms and optimizing warehouse logistics with machine learning. We want to provide the best customer experience and that’s why we need you on board.
This job will suit you if you’re excited to build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning models and build custom models to solve unique challenges together with a team of highly motivated engineers.
In short, you will
Build machine learning models with a major impact on our product
Simplify, maintain and improve our already existing models
Build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning development
Keep up with ML development with the team on weekly deep dives
Make use of your skills in Tensorflow/Pytorch, Python and SQL

Requirements
B.S or M.S. degree in Computer Science or related field
At least 2 years of working experience within the machine learning field
Strong proficiency in Python
In-depth expertise about machine learning algorithms, deep learning and LLMs
Experience with ML frameworks such as Tensorflow or PyTorch
Experience with AWS or similar cloud service providers
Experience with relational databases and SQL
Experience of setting up ML systems in production
Written and spoken fluency in English

We’d be impressed if you have
Previous experience with recommender systems
Previous experience with using ML systems for item valuation
Knowledge about how to build efficient data pipelines for large data volumes
Experience working with vector databases

You’ll get to
Be part of a tech-minded company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will get direction, energy, and work on meaningful challenges daily
Benefit from hybrid work from our offices at Medborgarplatsen, Rosersberg and from home
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform
Grow professionally during monthly level-up days
Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday and more)
Save up with a monthly pension plan
Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities

Location
You are welcome to do all these things from our office at Medborgarplatsen in Stockholm, and from home. Ideally, we’d love to see you in the office frequently, as it helps create a positive and productive environment.
Hybrid work
We work flexibly but value being together. During your first period, you’ll be on-site more often to get settled. Moving forward, we maintain a 50% office presence, with some flexibility depending on your team and tasks.
Our Interview Process 🤝
We want to get to know you, your way of thinking, and how we would work together.
Culture Interview (45 min): A video call to get to know each other. We talk about your background, your drive, and why you are interested in Sellpy.
Technical Interview (1 hour): A deep dive into your technical knowledge and how you approach problem-solving.
Case Interview (2 hours): You will receive a real-world case assignment to prepare in advance. We then invite you to our office at Medborgarplatsen where you will present your solution and we will discuss your reasoning in depth.
Founder Interview (30 min): A final chat with one of our founders to discuss the company vision and your potential journey with us.

Form of employment: Full-time
Start: As agreed upon

jobs.occupation: Junior Supply and Demand Coordinator Student position
jobs.description:
About the company
AbbVie is one of the world’s leading research biopharma companies, and we develop innovative treatments and sustainable care solutions for severe diseases within the focus areas immunology, neurology, oncology, eyecare and virology. Patient orientation is key, and the company aims to develop specialized treatments and medicines for unsolved health problems. Our vision is to improve the lives of people affected by disease. 52+ million patients in 175+ countries are treated by AbbVie’s medicines every year.
Your role
This is a student position as a Junior Demand & Supply Coordinator, where you will be part of AbbVie’s supply chain function for Scandinavia, covering four countries including Iceland. You will report to the Manager Demand & Supply Scandinavia and work closely with Commercial, Finance, Quality, Medical and Regulatory.
The role involves a lot of hands-on operational work, from order-to-cash to warehouse and inventory flows. Many of these processes are still manual and Excel-driven, and this is where you come in. Once you understand how things work today, your main mission is to make them smarter by using AI and other tools to automate repetitive routine tasks.
Key responsibilities
Identify and automate manual processes using AI, Excel and other tools
Monitor overall inventory, including stock management
Manage pharma orders together with AbbVie’s centralized service functions and external partners, including shipping and packing notifications, certificate uploads and backorder management
Monitor wholesaler inventory and handle exceptions with internal stakeholders
Maintain master data (price, material, customer) together with the central SAP service team
Carry out internal control activities and take part in internal and external audits
Contribute to various projects across the team

Qualifications
Ongoing university studies in a relevant field, for example in IT, engineering, supply chain, logistics or finance.
Strong interest in and hands-on experience with AI tools and Excel
Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, is a plus
Fluent in English, and preferably one Scandinavian language, both spoken and written

As a person, you take initiative and drive your work forward on your own. You’re structured and have an eye for detail, and have strong analytical skills and a structured, administrative mindset.
You communicate clearly with colleagues across functions and countries. You’re quick-thinking and technically curious, and you enjoy figuring things out yourself, especially when it means making a process simpler or faster. You’re comfortable working independently but also thrive as part of a team in an international environment.
Location: Solna, Stockholm
Scope: 2 days per week. Hours/days of work could be increased during summer to cover the vacations.
This is a consulting assignment, where you will be employed by us at Clevry but work on-site with our client AbbVie.
About Clevry
For over 30 years we have been the change maker for a more soft skills driven work-life within talent acquisition, assessments and advisory. We operate globally with customers, consultants and candidates from North America to Singapore with headquarters in Brighton, Stockholm and Helsinki. At Clevry we have over 150 soft skills certified recruiters, business psychologists and experts at your service.
The process
Clevry thinks your soft skills are as important as your hard skills. Do you want to know more about your soft skills and how to optimize them?
As you apply for this position you have the possibility to answer a questionnaire from us about your soft skills. The questionnaire takes approximately 10 minutes to fill out and generates a feedback report that highlights your soft skills. This report can be used for both personal and professional purposes.
Both questionnaire and feedback report are sent to your e-mail inbox.
We screen candidates continuously and the position could be filled prior to last application date. If you have any questions regarding this position or this recruitment process, do not hesitate to contact us at linnea.tylenius@clevry.com. Does this role sound like a good match? Please apply today.
Follow us on LinkedIn: Clevry Sweden

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
to Ursviken Technology in Västerås
Ursviken Technology is expanding! We are establishing a new engineering office in Västerås and looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our growing international engineering team.
Are you passionate about software development, advanced automation, and intelligent industrial machines? Would you like to help shape the future of industrial technology while being part of something new?
This is an opportunity to work with advanced industrial machinery, develop machine control software, and contribute to the establishment of a new engineering office.
About Ursviken Technology
Ursviken Technology develops advanced CNC-controlled machinery for the sheet metal processing industry, including press brakes, shears, and automated manufacturing systems. With more than 140 years of industrial engineering experience, we are known for technical excellence, innovation, and customized machine solutions.
We are part of Vaski Group, a growing Finnish industrial technology group, and are investing in our engineering capabilities and future product development.
About the Role
As a Software Engineer specializing in Industrial Automation and Machine Control, you will develop and improve the software that powers our machines. You will work with both new machine development and existing products, contributing throughout the development process, from software design and programming to testing and commissioning.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Developing and maintaining PLC and machine control software.
Working with motion control, servo axes, hydraulics, and CNC-related functionality.
Integrating robotic systems and external automation equipment.
Testing, troubleshooting, and improving software solutions.
Collaborating with colleagues in software, automation, electrical engineering, and mechanical design.
Contributing to the development of common software platforms, reusable components, and engineering standards.

You will work with PLC programming in B&R Automation Studio, primarily using Structured Text (ST). The role may also involve C/C++ development for more advanced functions and integrations.
Technology Development and New Opportunities
We are strengthening our in-house software development capabilities and investing in our own machine control technologies. This creates exciting opportunities to contribute to new software architectures, shared platforms, and improved development methods.
You will also have the opportunity to help establish our new engineering office in Västerås, influence technical decisions, and collaborate with experienced engineers at our headquarters in Ursviken and across Vaski Group.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine interest in programming, automation, and industrial machinery.
We believe you have:
A degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in PLC programming or industrial control software development.
An understanding of industrial automation and machine control.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Good communication skills and fluency in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

Experience with B&R Automation Studio, Siemens TIA Portal, Structured Text, C/C++, motion control, CNC technology, or industrial robot integration is an advantage. Most importantly, you are curious, take initiative, and enjoy developing reliable and maintainable software.
What We Offer
At Ursviken Technology, you will work with advanced industrial machinery and challenging engineering projects in an international environment. You will have the opportunity to influence our products, contribute to exciting technology development, and grow professionally as our organization expands.
You will join an established company with a long engineering history while helping build a new team and shape the future of our machine control systems.
If you enjoy combining software engineering with real-world machines and want to see your code bring powerful industrial equipment to life, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. Welcome to the team!
We look forward to receiving your application! We are collaborating with Skills Rekrytering for this recruitment. Please submit your application by November 22 via www.skillsrekrytering.se/lediga-jobb (https://www.skillsrekrytering.se/lediga-jobb?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Annika Frii at Skills Rekrytering on +46 70 335 52 90.

Senior Project Engineer – Control & Protection Software, Sequence & Interlocking HVDC
Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. We develop interlocking principles, automated switching sequences, operating states, and the conditions that determine when a station is ready to perform a specific action. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.
As HVDC technology continues to evolve, so do the challenges. New technologies, new customer requirements, and new ways of operating power systems continuously shape how we work. Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.
This is not a role for someone looking to simply execute predefined tasks. It is a role for you who want to understand how things work, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the future of HVDC technology.
“As managers, our goal is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work while continuing to develop their skills and expertise. We strongly believe in open technical discussions, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and a psychologically safe environment where questions, feedback, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value every person's voice and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.” Andrew Carruthers & Richard Palm, Hiring Managers
How you'll make an impact
Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Transform system and customer requirements into robust operational logic and engineering solutions.
Work closely with system design, control, protection, testing, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Take technical ownership of specific functions, systems, or project areas.
Verify and validate solutions through testing, troubleshooting, and system integration activities.
Support commissioning activities and experience how your engineering decisions perform in the real world.
Drive technical discussions both internally and with customers.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers while contributing to the development of our team's technical capability.
Contribute to future methods, tools, and technical solutions within Sequence & Interlocking.

Your background
We care more about technical capability and your personal skills than matching every item on a checklist. You likely have:
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience working with complex technical systems.
Experience in HVDC, FACTS, substation automation, protection and control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or similar fields.
Experience with commissioning, protection systems, relay applications, operational sequencing, or HVDC projects is highly valued.
Strong analytical skills and an ability to understand interactions across multiple systems and disciplines.
The confidence to challenge assumptions and contribute to technical discussions.
A structured approach and a curios mindset to engineering and problem solving.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
Professional communication skills in English.

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
More benefits could be connected to this specific role

More about us
Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Welcome to apply!
Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43. All other questions should be directed to Talent Partner Julia Wiklund, Julia.wiklund1@hitachienergy.com

Technogarden Life Science has extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, scientific research, biotechnology, medical technology, and food production. We always work according to the latest standards and regulations, and with great personal commitment.
In order to support our clients in the best possible way, we offer both consultants and recruitment in Life Science and MedTech. Thus, we can provide guidance, training, and seminars about the latest regulations. We are attentive to the world around us and knowledge transfer is an important part of every successful recruitment or consulting job.
Quality Engineer | QA Specialist
Technogarden is currently recruiting a Quality Assurance Specialist/Quality Engineer within Medtech to a Stockholm/Solna based client that manufactures and markets assistive technology that supports communication, cognition, environmental control and personal safety. The company's products help people with disabilities and special needs live more independent lives.
You will join a collaborative organisation where quality, innovation and continuous improvement are part of everyday work, with the opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to products that make a meaningful difference.
About the role
As a Quality Engineer/QA Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring product quality throughout the supply chain and manufacturing process.
Working across the entire product lifecycle, you will collaborate with colleagues in Development, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Regulatory Affairs, as well as with external suppliers.
You will contribute to continuous improvement by identifying risks, solving quality-related challenges and helping to strengthen quality processes across the organization. From time to time, you will also lead and/or coordinate quality related projects and improvement initiatives.
The position is based in Solna, Stockholm, or Gothenburg and is part of the Operations organization and reports to the Quality Manager.

 
Key responsibilities
Quality systems and supplier quality
Support internal teams and suppliers in improving and developing quality practices
Perform internal quality audits according to ISO 13485
Lead supplier audits and follow up on findings

Problem solving and continuous improvement
Initiate continuous improvement initiatives across products, processes and suppliers
Lead and coordinate quality related improvement activities/projects
Support in the NC and CAPA process together with internal teams and suppliersBe an important part of investigating product quality issues and root cause analyses

Product quality
Support product verification, inspections and testing activities.
Contribute to developing and maintaining inspection and testing procedures for incoming materials, in process products and finished goods

Data and analysis
Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement
Monitor defect rates and follow up corrective action

Who are you?
You are a process-oriented person who works well independently but also enjoy collaborating across different functions and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You are curious, eager to learn and motivated by finding practical solutions that improve products and the way we work through our processes.
You enjoy combining analytical thinking with a practical approach to problem solving. You are proactive, structured and comfortable taking ownership of your work.
We believe you have
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Science or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
At least 2–5 years of experience within Quality Engineering and/or Quality Assurance, preferably in a regulated industry within medical device.
Good knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485.
Experience working with quality tools such as FMEA, Root Cause Analysis, 8D, CAPA or Six Sigma.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Professional communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

The position enables you to work either from Stockholm or hybrid from Gothenburg, traveling to suppliers and subsidiaries are part of the position. If you would like to thrive and develop within a small but high-paced company - this should be an interesting fit. We look forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Danish-speaking Sales Development Representative to Debtist
jobs.description:
About the company
Debtist is a fast-growing German tech company developing a digital platform for accounts receivable management and debt collection. With a modern, data-driven approach, they are redefining how businesses manage their receivables and collections. Debtist has been recognized as one of Europe's most exciting growth companies and is featured on Sifteds prestigious Future 50 list of Europe's most promising scaleups.
Debtist is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its presence across Europe, including Sweden, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Germany. As part of this expansion, we are looking to welcome several new members to our sales team across these markets, which includes Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives.
In this role, you will play a key part in Debtist's growth journey, identifying new business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and driving sales across new markets.
At Asta Agency, we are partnering with Debtist in this recruitment process. The recruitment process is managed by Asta Agency, and you will be employed directly by Debtist.
About the role
As an SDR at Debtist, you will be a key player in establishing the Danish market. You will work with outbound sales and new business development, with the mission to identify and reach decision-makers at mid-sized and large companies. Your focus is on creating qualified business opportunities, and you will also play an active part in shaping how Debtist sells in Denmark.
Your responsibilities include:

Prospecting and contacting decision-makers via cold calling, email and LinkedIn

Qualifying potential customers and booking demos

Building and managing your own pipeline in CRM

Adapting sales messaging to the Danish market

Working in a structured way towards clear KPIs and delivering measurable results

There is also an opportunity to go into the role of Junior Account Executive, where, in addition to the responsibilities outlined above, you will take on greater responsibility for conducting customer demos, preparing quotes and commercial proposals, and driving sales opportunities forward through negotiations and closing deals.
Qualifications and personal qualities
We are looking for someone driven, curious and not afraid to take initiative. You are independent and comfortable taking ownership of your work, while remaining humble and attentive in your customer interactions. You build trust naturally and bring a hands-on, creative mindset to everything you do. You do not need extensive sales experience, but you need the right attitude and a genuine willingness to learn fast.
In addition, you have:

Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Experience working independently in a target-driven environment, with a structured approach to managing daily activities and KPIs.

Experience in professional communication with customers or prospects, preferably within sales, customer service, or business development.

Experience with high-volume outbound outreach, including cold calling, lead generation, and consistent follow-up to achieve set targets.

Meriting experience:

Previous experience in B2B sales, outbound or an SDR role

Experience from a SaaS or tech company

Familiarity with CRM and digital sales tools

Knowledge of German

Additional information
Start: As soon as possible

Location: Stockholm, Sweden (possibility to work from Berlin)

Extent: Full-time

Salary: Upon agreement

 We apply ongoing selection in this process, which means the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore recommend that you apply as soon as possible!
If you have any questions or thoughts about Asta Agency's recruitment process, don't hesitate to reach out to maja@astaagency.se.
About Asta Agency

jobs.occupation: Dutch-speaking Sales Development Representative to Debtist
jobs.description:
About the company
Debtist is a fast-growing German tech company developing a digital platform for accounts receivable management and debt collection. With a modern, data-driven approach, they are redefining how businesses manage their receivables and collections. Debtist has been recognized as one of Europe's most exciting growth companies and is featured on Sifteds prestigious Future 50 list of Europe's most promising scaleups.
Debtist is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its presence across Europe, including Sweden, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Germany. As part of this expansion, we are looking to welcome several new members to our sales team across these markets, which includes Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives.
In this role, you will play a key part in Debtist's growth journey, identifying new business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and driving sales across new markets.
At Asta Agency, we are partnering with Debtist in this recruitment process. The recruitment process is managed by Asta Agency, and you will be employed directly by Debtist.
About the role
As an SDR at Debtist, you will be a key player in establishing the Dutch market. You will work with outbound sales and new business development, with the mission to identify and reach decision-makers at mid-sized and large companies. Your focus is on creating qualified business opportunities, and you will also play an active part in shaping how Debtist sells in the Netherlands.
Your responsibilities include:

Prospecting and contacting decision-makers via cold calling, email and LinkedIn

Qualifying potential customers and booking demos

Building and managing your own pipeline in CRM

Adapting sales messaging to the Dutch market

Working in a structured way towards clear KPIs and delivering measurable results

There is also an opportunity to go into the role of Junior Account Executive, where, in addition to the responsibilities outlined above, you will take on greater responsibility for conducting customer demos, preparing quotes and commercial proposals, and driving sales opportunities forward through negotiations and closing deals.
Qualifications and personal qualities
We are looking for someone driven, curious and not afraid to take initiative. You are independent and comfortable taking ownership of your work, while remaining humble and attentive in your customer interactions. You build trust naturally and bring a hands-on, creative mindset to everything you do. You do not need extensive sales experience, but you need the right attitude and a genuine willingness to learn fast.
In addition, you have:

Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

Experience working independently in a target-driven environment, with a structured approach to managing daily activities and KPIs.

Experience in professional communication with customers or prospects, preferably within sales, customer service, or business development.

Experience with high-volume outbound outreach, including cold calling, lead generation, and consistent follow-up to achieve set targets.

Meriting experience:

Previous experience in B2B sales, outbound or an SDR role

Experience from a SaaS or tech company

Familiarity with CRM and digital sales tools

Knowledge of German

Additional information
Start: As soon as possible

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands (possibility to work from Berlin)

Extent: Full-time

Salary: Upon agreement

 We apply ongoing selection in this process, which means the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore recommend that you apply as soon as possible!

HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
We are now strengthening our Order Planning team and are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Planner who combines hands-on planning expertise with a passion for analysis and continuous improvement. 
Would you like to improve product availability and build reliable supply flows in an international environment? In this role, you will turn data into decisions, proactively address supply risks, and develop planning processes that make a difference to our customers and business. 
 
About the Role
As a Supply Chain Planner in our team, you will report to the Planning Manager. You will work closely with suppliers, production sites, logistics centers, and internal stakeholders to balance product availability with inventory costs and obsolescence risk.
You will combine operational planning with analytical work and long-term improvements. You will improve planning performance, address supply challenges, and drive cross-functional improvements while sharing expertise and supporting fellow planners.
Key Responsibilities:
Analyze customer demand and forecasts, firm planned purchases and maintain delivery schedules.
Evaluate and improve planning parameters, lead times, safety stock, and order quantities.
Identify supply risks and emerging shortages, drive mitigation and recovery plans, and escalate structural issues when needed.
Lead root-cause analysis of recurring delays, shortages, and excess inventory, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented and followed up.
Monitor supplier confirmations, shipping schedules, carrier performance, and inbound deliveries, and optimize transport modes and delivery plans with relevant partners.
Proactively communicate supply risks, performance and recommended decisions across Logistics Centers and other stakeholders.
Drive improvements in planning processes where the ERP system is central
Lead or represent Order Planning in cross-functional supply chain and logistics projects, and coach planners by sharing expertise and best practices.

About You
We’re looking for a structured, proactive, curious and analytical planner who takes ownership and drives continuous improvement. You are comfortable balancing daily priorities with long-term development and influencing decisions across functions.
You bring:
Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in a related field.
Solid experience in supply chain planning, production planning and/or operational purchasing.
Hands-on ERP experience and a solid understanding of planning parameters, replenishment, lead times, safety stock, and inventory management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and translate data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience driving process improvements and collaborating with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to improve supply performance.
Advanced Excel skills and practical experience using AI and other digital tools to analyze data and support decision-making.
You communicate effectively in Swedish and English with both internal and external stakeholders, locally and internationally.

Why Join Us?
Take a central role in a global team and improve product availability, inbound supply reliability and planning processes.
Work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Be part of a culture that values continuous improvement.
Be part of a fast-growing company with the ability to adapt quickly and turn ideas into action.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Professional Front-end Developer – React & TypeScript
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week in the office
Domain: Digital Services & Customer-Facing Applications
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
Are you a passionate Front-end Developer with strong expertise in React and TypeScript? Do you enjoy building modern, responsive, and accessible web applications while taking ownership of features from initial requirements through production?
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a Professional Front-end Developer to join a digital product development team focused on delivering high-quality customer-facing digital services.
About the Role
You will develop and maintain customer-facing features for a modern digital portal, taking end-to-end ownership of front-end solutions — from requirements clarification and UX collaboration to implementation, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Working closely with Product Owners, UX designers, backend developers, and other engineering colleagues, you will contribute to front-end architecture, reusable components, application performance, and overall user experience.

Design and develop responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web applications using React and TypeScript.
Own front-end features throughout the complete development lifecycle, from requirements to production.
Build reusable, secure, maintainable, and well-tested UI components.
Integrate front-end applications with REST and GraphQL APIs.
Contribute to front-end architecture, state management, and technical design decisions.
Develop and maintain unit, component, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Improve application performance, accessibility, browser compatibility, observability, and reliability.
Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve applications in production.
Collaborate with Product Owners, UX designers, backend developers, and engineering teams.
Participate in constructive code reviews and share technical knowledge with colleagues.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, validating generated outputs for quality, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications
Demonstrated experience independently delivering front-end features in production environments.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
Experience with modern front-end architecture, reusable component design, and state management.
Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs and managing asynchronous application flows.
Practical knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, package management, and front-end build tools.
Experience with automated testing using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Understanding of web accessibility, responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimisation, and front-end security.
Ability to interpret Figma designs and collaborate effectively with UX designers.
Experience working in Agile product teams using Scrum or Kanban.
Strong ownership, analytical problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
Experience with design systems and component libraries.
Knowledge of Node.js, server-side rendering, or micro-frontend architecture.
Experience with WebSockets, event-driven user interfaces, or real-time applications.
Experience with AWS, observability tools, or cloud-hosted web applications.
Knowledge of clean architecture, reusable design principles, and front-end performance optimisation.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Kiro, MCP servers, or AI agents.
Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Interaction Design, or equivalent practical experience.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who:
Takes ownership and delivers features independently.
Has a strong user-focused mindset and an eye for detail.
Enjoys solving technical challenges and continuously improving applications.
Works effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
Shares knowledge and contributes to a collaborative engineering culture.
Is curious about modern front-end technologies and responsible AI-assisted development.

Working Arrangement
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
Work Model: Hybrid.
Office Presence: Minimum 3 days per week.
Team Environment: Collaborative digital product development with a strong focus on customer value and engineering excellence.

How to Apply
Are you ready to build modern digital experiences and take ownership of customer-facing applications from concept to production?
Submit your updated CV through the Hykmann careers portal: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Please highlight the following in your application:
Your professional experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Examples of front-end features you have independently delivered to production.
Experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and front-end architecture.
Automated testing experience and CI/CD knowledge.
Experience with accessibility, performance optimisation, and production monitoring.
Relevant experience with AI-assisted development tools, if applicable.

jobs.occupation: EY-Parthenon Senior Consultant | Strategy & Execution - Deal Technology
jobs.description:
The opportunity
 
At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we have reimagined strategic consulting for a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.
 
EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, working on Deal Technology where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will grow with it, from building your expertise to contributing to our offering, while supporting clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions.
 
 
Your key responsibilities
 
As a Senior Consultant, you will own defined workstreams within complex, time-critical engagements. Working with engagement managers, investors and M&A teams, you will turn technology, data and AI questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations that connect to transaction logic and business value creation.
 
Conducting analyses and leading workstreams in IT and technology due diligence, and presenting decision-relevant insights to project leaders and clients.
Supporting carve-out, separation and integration programmes, including TSA design, IT disentanglement and Day 1 readiness.
Contributing to AI-enabled operating model transformation and technology-led growth initiatives across AI, data, cloud, digital platforms, applications and ERP.
Delivering your workstreams with quality and on time, while supporting junior colleagues and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing team.

 
 
Skills and attributes for success
 
A relevant master's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a comparable field.
Relevant experience from strategy or management consulting, transaction advisory, M&A or complex technology-enabled change, including working in client teams and delivering defined workstreams.
Exposure to digital, data and AI or core IT, ERP and infrastructure, with an interest in developing across both areas and connecting technology choices to business outcomes.
A structured, hands-on approach, strong analytical and communication skills, and fluency in English.

 
 
Ideally, you will also have
 
Experience from technology or IT in transactions, separations or integrations, or knowledge of ERP, cloud, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data or AI in a deal context.
Early experience of guiding junior colleagues or contributing to proposals and client opportunities.
Experience working with private equity investors or corporate M&A functions in the Nordics, plus a Nordic language.

 
 
What we offer you
 
Complex, high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in transaction environments.
A collaborative, inclusive and entrepreneurial team culture with strong opportunities to learn and grow.
Modern offices in central Stockholm and Gothenburg, with flexible ways of working.

 
Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.
 
 
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 
Application deadline: 22nd of November 2026. For questions about the recruitment process, contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
 
At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you need assistance or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

We now want to employ a Payroll Administrator. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:
1. Job Purpose
The Payroll Administrator is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll administration for the company's employees in accordance with Swedish labour legislation, applicable collective bargaining agreements (Collective Agreements), company policies, and tax regulations.
The role involves managing the complete monthly payroll process, maintaining employee payroll records, handling salary-related inquiries, and coordinating with HR, Finance, external payroll providers, and relevant authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Payroll Administration
Prepare, process, and verify monthly payroll for employees.
Ensure salaries are calculated accurately and paid on the agreed payment dates.
Process fixed salaries, hourly wages, overtime, additional allowances, bonuses, and other salary components.
Calculate and administer holiday pay (Semesterlön), holiday compensation (Semesterersättning), and vacation balances.
Process sick leave, parental leave, unpaid leave, and other absence-related salary adjustments.
Verify working hours, timesheets, attendance records, and approved overtime.
Handle salary corrections, retroactive payments, deductions, and final salary settlements.

B. Collective Agreement Compliance
Ensure payroll calculations comply with applicable Swedish Collective Agreements, including Unionen and Installatörsföretagen agreements, as applicable.
Apply relevant provisions concerning overtime, additional compensation, working hours, holiday entitlements, and other employment benefits.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of changes in collective agreements and Swedish employment legislation.
Support HR in payroll-related union inquiries and collective agreement compliance matters.

C. Employee Records and Documentation
Maintain accurate employee payroll records and personal data.
Register new employees and update employment-related payroll information.
Process changes in salary, bank details, tax information, and employment status.
Prepare payslips and respond to employee questions regarding salary calculations.
Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with GDPR and data protection requirements.

D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with HR and Finance departments regarding payroll matters.
Communicate with external payroll consultants, accounting firms, and relevant authorities when required.
Prepare payroll reports, salary summaries, and monthly payroll reconciliations.
Assist with budgeting, payroll cost analysis, and financial reporting.
Identify payroll discrepancies and recommend improvements to payroll procedures.

3. Qualifications and Requirements
Previous experience in payroll administration in Sweden.
Good knowledge of Swedish payroll regulations and employment legislation.
Understanding of Swedish Collective Agreements, particularly Unionen and Installatörsföretagen.
Knowledge of Swedish tax regulations and Skatteverket reporting requirements.
Experience with payroll systems and HR administration tools.
Good numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
High attention to detail and ability to meet strict payroll deadlines.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

4. Language Requirements
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Good command of Swedish is highly desirable.
Turkish language skills are considered an advantage.

5. Personal Competencies
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
Excellent planning and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to identifying and resolving payroll discrepancies.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Payroll Administrator's performance will be evaluated based on:
Accuracy of monthly payroll processing.
Timely salary payments.
Compliance with Swedish legislation and collective agreements.
Timely submission of statutory payroll reports.
Number of payroll discrepancies and correction requests.
Timely resolution of employee payroll inquiries.
Accuracy and completeness of payroll documentation.
